note: Eau Claire Campground in Spray Valley Provincial Park, 40 km south of Hwy 1 on Hwy 40 (Kananaskis Trail), run by Cedar & Spruce Campgrounds: well-spaced sites among pine and spruce, a playground, food lockers for hiker-cyclists, and the Eau Claire Interpretive Trail to the Kananaskis River. Bring drinking water: the hand pump is for putting out fires only. Firewood from the campground manager. --Claude
